flagged_sentences: Mine manager Don Duncan then placed roughly two million tons of run-of-mine cutoff ore on prepared pads beginning in 1971.

Laboratory tests on Cortez samples showed that ore crushed only to three-quarter-inch size and stacked in heaps still released about 70 percent of its gold when leached for seven days with dilute sodium cyanide solution.

claims.claim: Cortez heap-leached roughly two million tons of run-of-mine cutoff ore beginning in 1971.
claims.episode_span: Mine manager Don Duncan then placed roughly two million tons of run-of-mine cutoff ore on prepared pads beginning in 1971.
claims.source_title: Mining “Invisible” Gold: Heap Leaching and Nevada’s Contribution to Twentieth-Century Gold Mining
claims.supporting_quote: Cortez as first large-scale operation leaching ~2 million tons of run-of-mine cutoff ore in early 1970s

claims.claim: Heap leaching at Carlin used ore crushed to 3/4 inch placed on asphalt pads and leached seven days with dilute cyanide, recovering about 70 percent of the gold.
claims.episode_span: Laboratory tests on Cortez samples showed that ore crushed only to three-quarter-inch size and stacked in heaps still released about 70 percent of its gold when leached for seven days with dilute sodium cyanide solution.
claims.source_title: Heap Leaching Practice At the Carlin Gold Mining Company, Carlin, Nevada.
claims.supporting_quote: Selected open pit ore containing about 0.07 Ounce gold per ton is crushed to 3/4 inch, dumped by truck on an asphalt pad, and leached by sprinkling with dilute cyanide solution for 7 days. ... About 70 percent of the gold is dissolved.
